## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe clearly. (e.g. "I am always frustrated when...")

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how the CLI should behave.

## Proposed Command & Output Example
```text
$ lantern <new-subcommand-or-flag>
example output here
```

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Scope & Architectural Alignment
Does this proposal fit Lantern's core mission (local-first developer security, configuration causality, zero outbound network telemetry)?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or mockups here.
